name: California spiny lobster
size: 3.25 in carapace (eye socket to rear of shell)
spear: Hand or hoop net only, no spear
notes: Divers: hands only, no hooked device; a spear may be carried but not used on lobster. Measure in the water; shorts never leave the water or enter a bag. Keep whole. Carry a gauge. Report card: fill in BEFORE entering the water. Hoop nets max 5/person, 10/vessel.

name: Rock crabs (red/yellow/brown)
size: 4 in across widest part of shell
spear: Hands only (or hoop net); no spear
notes: Reg text says Cancer genus incl. yellow, rock, red crabs; CDFW applies it to red (C. productus), yellow (Metacarcinus anthonyi), brown (Romaleon antennarium). Measure immediately, release undersize at once, none in any container. Carry gauge. Divers hands only. Crab traps only N of Pt Arguello.

name: Sheep crab (spider crab)
spear: Hands only (or hoop net); no spear
notes: No species-specific section; booklet table 'Crab, Other: 35 crabs, no size, §29.05'. Divers hands only, no hooked device (§29.80(g)). Hoop nets may take all crab species. Same 35 covers other non-Cancer crabs (kelp crab etc.).

name: Rock scallop
spear: Hand, dive knife or ab iron only; no spear
notes: Only hand, dive knife or abalone iron (iron per §29.15(e)). Up to 3 limits on a declared multi-day boat trip (§27.15). Some SMCAs (e.g. Kashtayit) exclude rock scallops from allowed take; check MPA rules. Allowed in intertidal zone.

name: Red sea urchin
spear: Hand take; spear not an authorized method
notes: 35 per species (§29.06(a)). Skin/scuba divers may take (§29.05(d)). Listed tidepool species, so intertidal take allowed outside MPAs. Take of all inverts prohibited in state marine reserves.

name: Purple sea urchin
spear: Hand take; spear not an authorized method
notes: 40-gallon limit and Caspar Cove unlimited take apply ONLY to Humboldt/Mendocino/Sonoma - not SoCal. In SoCal: 35/day, no possession limit. Divers may take.

name: Octopus
spear: PROHIBITED by spear (hands or hook & line only)
notes: Mollusk: may be taken only by hook and line or with the hands (§29.10). Bag 35 under general limit. Allowed in intertidal (listed species) outside MPAs.

name: Warty sea cucumber
spear: Hand only per CDFW; no spear
notes: No dedicated section; §29.05 general 35 applies. NOT on the §29.05(b) tidepool list: no take between high tide mark and 1,000 ft seaward (intertidal/nearshore). CDFW species page states hands only (page could not be read directly; confirmed via search snippet only). Same for giant red sea cucumber.

name: Market squid
spear: Hand-held dip net (or hands/hook & line); no spear
notes: §29.70: hand-held dip nets, no limit (also jumbo squid). Mollusk general rule §29.10 allows hands or hook and line. Listed tidepool species.

name: Mussels (California & bay)
bag: 10 lb in shell, both species combined
season: All year; CDPH quarantine May 1 - Oct 31: bait use only
spear: Hand; no spear
notes: Annual CDPH quarantine (2026 notice SN26-008) May 1 through normally Oct 31, may be extended: sport mussels may only be harvested for bait, do not eat (PSP/domoic acid). Southern summary Sep 2026: non-consumptive use only. Kashtayit SMCA excludes mussels. Biotoxin line 800-553-4133.

name: Pismo clam
size: 4.5 in shell diameter (south of SLO/Monterey line)
season: All year (SoCal); hours 1/2 hr before sunrise to 1/2 hr after sunset
spear: Hand-operated digging tools only; no spear
notes: Hand tools only (spade, shovel, fork, rake, clam gun); no digging tools on beach at night. Measure at once, rebury undersize where dug. Keep whole; each person own container, no commingling. Carry gauge. No take in MPAs that prohibit clams. Check domoic acid advisories.

name: Littleneck/chione/cockle clams
size: 1.5 in greatest diameter (no size for soft-shell)
season: All year; hours 1/2 hr before sunrise to 1/2 hr after sunset
spear: Hand-operated digging tools only; no spear
notes: §29.35 group: littleneck, soft-shell, chiones, northern quahogs, cockles. All soft-shells dug must be retained until limit. General clam rules §29.20: hand tools only, rebury undersize, keep whole, separate container per person, carry gauge.

name: Gaper & Washington clams
season: All year; hours 1/2 hr before sunrise to 1/2 hr after sunset
spear: Hand-operated digging tools only; no spear
notes: Horse/horseneck clams = gaper clams. All gaper and Washington clams dug, regardless of size or broken condition, must be retained until limit reached. Humboldt Bay/Elkhorn Slough exceptions do not apply in SoCal. General clam rules §29.20 apply.

name: Abalone (all species)
spear: PROHIBITED - no take at all
notes: All species (red, green, pink, black, white). Booklet (Jul 17, 2026): all ocean waters closed; abalone may not be taken or possessed, closure runs to Apr 1, 2036. Southern summary: no abalone may be taken at any time in Southern California.

name: Kellet's whelk
spear: Hand or hook & line only; no spear
notes: Season Jul 1 through first Wednesday after Mar 15 (§29.17). Bag 35 via general limit. Mollusk: hands or hook and line only (§29.10). NOT on the tidepool list: no take between high tide mark and 1,000 ft seaward.

name: Moon snail
spear: Hand or hook & line only; no spear
notes: §29.71 limit 5; closure north of Golden Gate does not apply in SoCal. Mollusk: hands or hook and line (§29.10). Listed tidepool species.

name: Limpets
spear: Hand or hook & line only; no spear
notes: General 35 limit (§29.05); includes owl limpets. Mollusk: hands or hook and line. Listed tidepool species, but take of all inverts prohibited in state marine reserves and many SoCal SMCAs; check MPA.

name: Kelp & marine plants
bag: 10 lb wet weight, all plants aggregate
spear: Hand harvest; N/A
notes: §30.00 10 lb wet weight aggregate. §30.10: eelgrass (Zostera), surfgrass (Phyllospadix), sea palm (Postelsia) may not be cut or disturbed at all. No harvest in state marine reserves; some SMCAs restrict (Kashtayit allows giant kelp by hand only).

name: Speckled (bay) scallop
spear: PROHIBITED - no take at all
notes: §29.65: may not be taken or possessed. Found in SoCal bays/harbors. Do not confuse with rock scallop (10 limit).

name: Other invertebrates (general)
bag: 35 per species unless a specific limit applies
spear: Hands (crustaceans); hands/hook & line (mollusks)
notes: §29.05: 35 per species unless a specific limit; no closed season or size unless listed. No take of any invert in state marine reserves; SMCAs vary. Intertidal (high tide mark to 1,000 ft seaward): only listed species (lobster, crabs, urchins, octopus, mussels, rock scallop, limpets, clams, snails).
